name: Paizuri Cheerleader VS Sakunyuu Ouendan!
original_name: ぱいずりチアリーダーVS搾乳応援団！
source:
Shin belongs to a cheer group. Though he wasn't interested in it, Yuko, his older step-sister, forced him to join it.... As a matter of fact, there are only two members, Shin and Yuko. On the other hand, a cheerleading club has a lot of members. One day, Shin accidentally collides with Chieru, a member of the cheerleading club, and she gets injured.... In compensation for her injury, he decides to work as a caretaker of the cheerleading club. But days later, Satsuki, a coach of the cheerleading club, suddenly orders the members, "You should give him a titjob to overcome your sense of shame!" As they are all confused, Satsuki starts giving Shin a titjob...!

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
Shin属于啦啦队。尽管他对此不感兴趣，但他的继姐优子却强迫他加入……事实上，成员只有申和优子两个人。另一方面，啦啦队俱乐部有很多成员。有一天，申不小心与啦啦队成员千叶相撞，导致她受伤……为了补偿她的受伤，他决定担任啦啦队俱乐部的管理员。但几天后，啦啦操俱乐部的教练小月突然命令队员们：“你们应该给他乳头，以克服你们的羞耻感！”就在大家都一头雾水的时候，小月开始给进乳交……！
